subject: First make the internal design experimentation loop run end-to-end; do not chase experiment quantity yet
interpretation: Before broadening style/design experiments, establish a reliable internal closed loop that can repeatedly turn product intent and references into experiments, evidence, judgment, learning, and the next experiment without manual orchestration at every step.
loop_contract: 1. Read current New Westside parent goal, known invariants, experimental-only boundary, and existing visual-learning knowledge.
2. Select or research one bounded design hypothesis because it answers a concrete New Westside question, not because a template already exists.
3. Materialize a real editable experiment in Storybook/design lab or product sandbox using real or representative Westside content.
4. Build it deterministically and render in a real browser at desktop and mobile.
5. Collect technical evidence: render, function, responsive, accessibility, visual stability, assets, reduced motion where applicable.

6. Perform design evidence judgment separately from technical PASS: what was learned about composition, typography, materiality, information hierarchy, interaction, motion, bilingual behavior, and Westside identity.
7. Persist both accepted and rejected pattern learning with provenance; experimental observations must remain provisional and must not become user-approved brand rules.
8. Use that learning to generate the next materially informed hypothesis/experiment automatically, preserving the same New Westside parent goal.
9. Demonstrate at least one complete second iteration that consumes the previous iteration's learning. This proves the loop is actually closed rather than a one-shot pipeline.
10. If the loop itself fails, diagnose and repair the smallest reusable Doré capability gap, verify the repair in this same episode, then resume.
pass_boundary: INTERNAL_LOOP_PASS requires evidence of two consecutive experiment iterations where iteration 2 explicitly consumes durable learning from iteration 1, with browser evidence and no false product/style acceptance. One experiment, a research memo, a Storybook build alone, reference accumulation, or transport PASS is insufficient.
product_boundary: Do not select a winner, promote production, or claim the current visual style is accepted. New Westside remains EXPLORATION_INSUFFICIENT after this internal-loop milestone unless later user/product evidence changes it.
autonomy: Doré should run this internal loop with minimal user interruption. ChatGPT and Doré may repair execution/capability issues autonomously within existing architecture. Durable architecture relocation still follows prior governance.
output_required: iteration-1 hypothesis + artifact + desktop/mobile browser evidence + technical result + design learning
iteration-2 hypothesis showing explicit reuse of iteration-1 learning
iteration-2 artifact + browser evidence + technical/design result
canonical INTERNAL_LOOP_PASS or bounded FAIL/LEARNING receipt
